title: Explicit whole-diagram zipper rewrite variants
scope: Algebraic identities and explicit whole-word state metadata. No automatic reachability, termination, confluence, or complete normal-form engine is asserted.
parameter_policy: All conditions use the unchanged original base parameters. Inspect ports for actual transformed positions.
